rules.statement: Payment by cheque is a conditional payment, and when the cheque is honoured, that operates as a payment as from the date of the giving of the cheque.
rules.supporting_quote: "Generally speaking, payment by cheque is a conditional payment, and when the cheque is honoured, that operates as a payment as from the date of the giving of the cheque (Hadley v. Hadley [(1898) L. R. 2 Ch. 680.])."
